text: {"decision": "reject", "reason": "sets.mcmId is an external CardMarket vendor ID for MTG sets (sibling columns mcmIdExtras/mcmName/tcgplayerGroupId confirm this), while cards.id is an internal surrogate primary key for card printings (sequential 1–56832); the full containment with coverage of only 0.004 is just small integers (4–3660) falling trivially inside the target's range, so the overlap is coincidental and the columns denote different entities."}
